{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/claude-code-plugin-manifest.json",
  "name": "oh-my-claudeagent",
  "displayName": "Oh My ClaudeAgent",
  "version": "2.21.0",
  "description": "Claude Code, with receipts. Plans with you, hands each task to a specialist agent, and keeps a session from calling work done until a verification is logged.",
  "author": {
    "name": "UtsavBalar1231",
    "email": "utsavbalar1231@gmail.com",
    "url": "https://github.com/UtsavBalar1231"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/UtsavBalar1231/oh-my-claudeagent",
  "repository": "https://github.com/UtsavBalar1231/oh-my-claudeagent",
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "keywords": [
    "agents",
    "orchestration",
    "multi-agent",
    "planning",
    "delegation",
    "parallel-execution"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "enableKeywordTriggers": {
      "title": "Enable keyword triggers",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Adds a one-line hint naming the slash command when a prompt contains a trigger phrase such as \"create plan\".",
      "sensitive": false
    },
    "statuslineMode": {
      "title": "Statusline mode",
      "type": "string",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "on"
      ],
      "description": "on lets /oh-my-claudeagent:omca-setup point your status line and the subagent status line at OMCA's renderer; off makes setup leave both alone.",
      "sensitive": false
    },
    "disableForceOrchestrationStyle": {
      "title": "Disable forced orchestration output style",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": false,
      "description": "When true, removes the force-for-plugin: true line from the installed output-styles/omca-default.md cache copy so your own outputStyle setting takes precedence instead of the plugin's orchestration style. The strip is applied at /oh-my-claudeagent:omca-setup time; you must re-run omca-setup after every plugin update (or /plugin marketplace update omca) because the cache copy may be overwritten and the strip will need re-application.",
      "sensitive": false
    },
    "showBand": {
      "title": "Show the band above the prompt",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true,
      "description": "When false, the band with the bound plan, the last verification and the suggested next actions is not drawn.",
      "sensitive": false
    },
    "guardMode": {
      "title": "Destructive Bash guard mode",
      "type": "string",
      "default": "dialog",
      "options": [
        "dialog",
        "deny"
      ],
      "description": "dialog asks before a risky Bash or PowerShell command runs where a dialog can show; deny, and any session where none can show, refuses a blocking command and lets an advisory one run. A catastrophic removal is refused in both modes.",
      "sensitive": false
    }
  }
}
